SELECT d.dept_code, d.dept_name, d.parent_code, d.dept_level, d.sort_order, d.use_yn FROM tb_dept d
(d.dept_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.dept_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY d.dept_level, d.sort_order, d.dept_code

SELECT d.dept_code, d.dept_name, d.parent_code, p.dept_name AS parent_name, d.dept_level, d.sort_order, d.use_yn, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.updated_by, d.updated_at FROM tb_dept d LEFT JOIN tb_dept p ON p.dept_code = d.parent_code WHERE d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
SELECT user_id AS emp_id, user_nm AS emp_nm FROM tb_user WHERE dept_code = #{deptCode} ORDER BY user_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_dept (dept_code, dept_name, parent_code, dept_level, sort_order, use_yn, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{parentCode}, #{deptLevel}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_dept SET dept_name = #{deptName}, parent_code = #{parentCode}, dept_level = #{deptLevel}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE dept_code = #{deptCode}
